final: SELECT link_to_event, location, avg_val, rnk FROM (SELECT b.link_to_event AS link_to_event, e.location AS location, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / b.amount) AS avg_val, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY e.location ORDER BY (AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / b.amount) IS NULL), AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / b.amount) DESC) AS rnk FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY b.link_to_event, e.location) WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY location, rnk
